rubric.role_summary: Onsite warehouse supervisor for a rapid grocery delivery site in Brighton, overseeing order picking and dispatch, inventory accuracy, warehouse safety, and day-to-day operations.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Onsite warehouse supervisor for a rapid grocery delivery site in Brighton, overseeing order picking and dispatch, inventory accuracy, warehouse safety, and day-to-day operations.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience working effectively in fast-paced environments; FMCG, retail, warehouse, or last-mile delivery experience is a major plus.
- Track record of meeting targets such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Brighton - St Josephs Business Park area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
